expectations.text: At a 320px viewport, the page has no horizontal scroll (document scrollWidth at most 320)
expectations.evidence: documentElement.scrollWidth = 320 at 320px (400 at 400px); pre scrolls inside its box (overflow-x: auto, scrollWidth 668 vs clientWidth 288), table 288 = 288.

expectations.text: Body paragraphs in the article compute hyphens: auto
expectations.evidence: Both article p compute hyphens: auto, auto at 320px and 400px; from `.doc { hyphens: auto; text-align: start }`.

expectations.text: Inline code and pre do not hyphenate: they compute hyphens none or manual
expectations.evidence: pre computes hyphens: auto (inherited from `.doc { hyphens: auto }`; only `.doc code` sets manual), so it fails even though its code child computes manual. Computed: code: manual; pre: auto; code (in pre): manual.

expectations.text: At a 320px viewport, every value cell in the settings table renders on a single line, so no number is split from its unit
expectations.evidence: At 320px every value cell (2,5 GB, 1 500 kr, 30 dagar, 12 h) has 1 client rect via Range, height 18px vs 21px line-height; `.doc td:last-child { white-space: nowrap }`.

expectations.text: Body paragraphs are not justified (computed text-align is start or left)
expectations.evidence: Both article p compute text-align: start, start at 320px and 400px.

expectations.text: At a 320px viewport, the h1 does not overflow its own box (its scrollWidth is no larger than its clientWidth)
expectations.evidence: h1 scrollWidth 288 vs clientWidth 288 at 320px (368 vs 368 at 400px); h1 is 24px with hyphens auto.
